name: scene-specifications-builder-blender-mcp
description: Creates a four-panel scene blueprint for visual approval, then exports matching Blender-ready JSON.

interface.longDescription: Turns a textual story, environment, or object description into a coordinated four-panel visual blueprint. It inventories the described scene, proposes measurable spatial relationships, and presents the blueprint for explicit human approval. Only after approval does it export matching schema-validated scene JSON for a Blender add-on or an existing verified Blender MCP workflow. The illustration documents design intent; the confirmed JSON is authoritative for construction.
defaultPrompt: Draw a modern jazz café layout with an espresso station, cozy seating, warm lighting, and jazz-club design.
Draw a Georgian jewel in high-karat or silver-topped gold, with foil-backed closed-set emeralds.
Draw a Central Asian yurt: round lattice frame, layered sheep-wool felt, built for extreme weather and fierce winds.

publication.release_notes: Adds a complete visual-approval workflow, exhaustive story-object inventory, a checked JSON handoff contract, three starter prompts, marketplace packaging, and a production icon.
